install: pip install -e 'benchmarks/week1[test]' equivalent satisfied by pytest+ruff above

deviations: week1 pins numpy>=1.24,<2; the only host interpreter is CPython 3.13.14, which has no numpy<2 wheel. Installed numpy 2.5.3 with --no-deps and verified the driver/scorer end to end. Precedent: the week1 audio-validity study on this machine ran the same pinned checkout against sandbox numpy 2.x.

The subject's check report notes 6 graded-run packages missing locally (IPython, librosa, llvmlite, numba, scipy, soundfile). The miniature adapters are numpy-only, so no fixture reads a skipped module; the note is captured verbatim in every raw bundle.
